//: Format every file the agent writes, immediately, via a PostToolUse hook. This repo has one formatter for everything, so both matchers call biome. Note what is NOT here: no `permissions` block — an agent's permission posture is a per-profile CLI flag at launch, not a checked-in allowlist.

hooks.command: f="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css) root=$(cd "$(dirname "$f")" && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$root" ] && (cd "$root" && bunx biome check --write "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1) ;; esac
